formRaceEntries.comment: Not in the best going two starts ago, keen after bounding in the air and losing two lens at the start last time.
Stuck on well at Geelong, unlucky when in an awkward spot here, strong late at Ararat. A win looks close.
Good on the heavy going two starts ago but at the rear last time. Drops in class & trip for this.
Raced wide last start and was not disgraced. Placed both runs here and should not be far away as usual.
Rose in class at Wodonga and was solid in the placings. Should be honest again back at this level.
Has proven a bit disappointing at last couple. Will need to be at best but the class drop helps.

formRaceEntries.comment: Thereabouts of late, not always having the best of luck. Looks suited in this class.

formRaceEntries.comment: Too well beaten last time out to recommend here.
Racing well but in easier company. Needs to improve.
Resumes for new stable (ex G Crothers). Unplaced all first-up runs & likely to need this as well.

formRaceEntries.lastGear: Cross-over Nose Band AGAIN, Tongue Tie OFF AGAIN

formRaceEntries.comment: Resumes. First-up record is sound & goes OK over this trip. 7th/10 in a Cranbourne jumpout 18/5.
Tired from the lead two starts ago, same tactics last start - that race run to suit the swoopers. Rough place hope.
Didn't finish it off at Mildura & only fair in this class at Ararat. Place hopes look best.
Lines up for 98th start having won 8 times at this trip - three of those at this track. Suited at this level.
Pushed forward & boxed on OK at Seymour last time. Could place again despite the tough draw.
Resumes. Good effort on debut last time in. Close 4th/10 in a Caulfield Heath trial 23/4. Market?
